text:
3 golfers from Scottsdale, Arizona played at the Wyndham Championship on Sunday, Aug. 9
By
L. L. KaiserThree golfers from Scottsdale, Arizona played in the Wyndham Championship on the PGA Tour, which concluded Sunday, Aug. 9, in Greensboro, North Carolina.
Kevin Yu had the best local finish, placing fourth at 264, 16-under par.
Matt McCarty, also from Scottsdale, tied for 29th at 272, 8-under par, while Tony Finau, also from Scottsdale, finished tied for 61st at 276, 4-under par.
Michael Brennan won the tournament at 258, 22-under par. Beau Hossler was second at 261, 19-under par, and Ben James was third at 262, 18-under par.
